outlook.statement: Premiumization — industry demand is shifting toward eco-friendly, technically advanced and ethically sourced fabrics; capturing that shift, rather than competing purely on volume, is the clearest lever against the material-cost pressure seen this year.

Sustainability with substance — building an actual, measured energy and water programme on top of this year's electricity-and-coal disclosure, so that next year's Sustainable Fabric section can report real progress rather than intentions.

Capacity and scale — continuing the plant and machinery investment already under way (gross block up from ₹2,865.02 lakh to ₹4,222.55 lakh this year), while working to convert modest export earnings into a genuine second growth engine alongside the domestic business.
The outlook for the Company's products appears to be good and the Company is confident of achieving improved operational performance.

Domestic Home Textile category continues to evolve faster in India. Increased penetration of organized retail, favorable demographics, and rising income levels are likely to drive demand for home textiles. GST implementation has helped the organized retailers by reducing influx of cheap alternatives from abroad and domestic unorganized industry. While on one hand, influence of competitively priced private labels in Modern Trade and E-com marketplaces is bringing in new value conscious consumers to the industry; on other hand, fashion led premium consumer's preferences are switching over to product made from high end fabrics and innovative designs. The market is clearly drawing distinction between the value led and the fashion-conscious consumers.

key_audit_matters: Revenue Recognition: Revenue is recognized as disclosed in significant accounting policies whereby discount, rate difference and claims are disclosed separately as other expense in Note No- 29. Owing to the variety of products, different designs of products, product specifications, credit terms, delivery terms and other terms of supply and job work, discounts, rate difference and claims, recognition and measurement of revenue discount etc involves a significant amount of management judgment and estimation. The value of discounts, rate difference and claims together with the level of judgment involved, make its accounting treatment, a significant matter for the audit.
